## **Global**

```{r,include=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
install.packages("psych", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
Data <- read_csv("project_traindata.csv")

```

## **Numerical Variables**

```{r,include=FALSE}

NumerciVar <- Data %>% select(where(is.numeric))

Numerical_Variable_Analysis <- function(Dataset,variable = NumerciVar) {

  IndVar <- Dataset %>% pull(all_of(variable))
   print(kable(round(describe(IndVar), 2), caption = variable))
  print(t.test(IndVar)$conf.int)
  
  
}

```

#### 1.Model_year

```{r}
Numerical_Variable_Analysis(Dataset = Data, variable = "model_year")

```
